# On_Chip_STDP_Learning

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
Spike-Timing-Dependent Plasticity implemented directly in hardware for real-time synaptic weight updates. Enables continuous, local, and unsupervised learning without external memory access, critical for edge neuromorphic systems.
